Season 8 comes with a few tweaks, most notably that the highest division is called "'''Open division'''". In this division any player can decide to step up and play with the big guys in case he/she think they got what it takes. This is in '''addition''' to playing in their regular division. Besides the Open division consisting of the best opponents there are, it also features more games than the other divisions as best-of-five match format is used earlier than for the other divisions.
